packageRules.description: Major updates wait for an approval in the Dependency Dashboard: they change behaviour and are reviewed one by one.
Expo SDK upgrades are done deliberately with `expo install --fix`, not by Renovate.
The overrides of pnpm-workspace.yaml are security pins chosen by hand for an indirect dependency (see the comments there): never bumped by Renovate.
Better Auth packages pin each other exactly (and the app pins @better-auth/utils to satisfy @better-auth/core's peer): update them together.
